generic_domain.justification: Neural networks are a foundational concept in deep learning and encompass various other domains such as mathematical modeling, optimization methods (e.g., backpropagation), feature extraction (CNNs, RNNs), generative models (GANs), transformers (like those used in NLP), reinforcement learning, and even areas like Bayesian neural networks which tie into probabilistic modeling. As such, neural networks provide a broad framework that integrates many of the listed domains within deep learning.
